تتمالكين (form VI)
# تَتَمَالَكِينَ (tatamālakīna) /ta.ta.maː.la.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# تُتَمَالَكِينَ (tutamālakīna) /tu.ta.maː.la.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
